title: Register the menu-contract sensor as a shared path and cut pantheon-base-v0.18.2
goal: Package the nine commits merged since pantheon-base-v0.18.1 (93505225) as a patch foundation release on release/0.18, and repair the release-surface gap that blocks the menu-contract repair from ever reaching the consumer: frontend/scripts/check-menu-contract.mjs is byte-identical to the copy pantheon-ops runs in its frontend prebuild, yet it is absent from the release manifest's sharedPaths, so the #471 parser fix can never arrive through a release. The package (1) declares the file shared (sharedPaths 52 -> 53) and required in scripts/foundation-release/frontend-ownership.mjs, with the manifest and cut test expectations updated, (2) writes VERSION 0.18.2, the CHANGELOG entry, docs/release-notes/RELEASE_NOTES_v0.18.2.md and both indexes, plus the .harness/STATUS.md section, and (3) publishes the four assets and advances pantheon-ops onto the release with rebuild:from-base, check:business-overlay, check:shared-drift at 0 modified, go build ./... and npm run build. No backend source, frontend source, schema, route, permission, menu key or i18n key changes.
findings: frontend/scripts/check-menu-contract.mjs is byte-identical between pantheon-base v0.18.1 and pantheon-ops; the consumer runs it from frontend/package.json prebuild, but the file is absent from sharedPaths, so #471's parser repair cannot reach the consumer through any release.

scripts/foundation-release/frontend-ownership.mjs guards required frontend entries at manifest-build time, but the menu-contract script was never added to that list either, which is why the omission went unnoticed.

Only two files changed in the consumer-visible surface since v0.18.1: frontend/scripts/check-menu-contract.mjs (#471) and backend/modules/business/retired_modules.go (#477). Everything else merged in the window is harness, workflow or documentation.

All nine commits since v0.18.1 are repairs: a sensor gap, six githubactions findings, a gate polling failure, an archive fallback and a SQL-literal cohesion fix. By VERSION_MANAGEMENT_GUIDE section 2.4 this is a patch, not a minor.

Growing sharedPaths from 52 to 53 changes the lock shape. rebuild-from-base.mjs and check-shared-drift.mjs both read the list from the lock, so no consumer script changes; check:shared-drift will report two modified files until the rebuild lands, which is the expected transition reading.
The release gate now tolerates a transiently failed check-list read (#478), so the cut no longer depends on a momentary api.github.com failure; the terminal timeout still fails closed.

implementationNotes: The registration gap is proven by comparison, not judgment: the ops copy and the base v0.18.1 copy differ by nothing, and the only delta against base main is #471 itself.
Adding the entry to requiredFrontendEntries turns a silent omission into a manifest-build failure, which is the ratchet for this class; no new sensor is introduced.
The 52 -> 53 change is documented in all three release texts because a consumer that pins the count must accept it, even though both consumer scripts read the list dynamically.

Publication preconditions are enforced by publish-foundation-release.mjs: clean worktree, successful Release Gate Summary on the target commit, manifest baseCommit equal to the target commit, four checksum-valid assets, non-placeholder notes.
The archive of this packet is a separate closeout commit after the release and consumption readings are recorded; the manifest status and paths are not rewritten here.
